title: Scale-Robust and Global-Aware Representation Learning for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.32033v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multivariate time series anomaly detection (MTSAD) is an essential task for identifying abnormal system behaviors and supporting reliable operations across diverse real-world applications. Despite substantial advances in MTSAD, two key challenges in representation learning remain underexplored: (C1) how to learn scale-robust temporal representations that capture anomalies across different temporal scales and (C2) how to learn global-aware relational representations that capture inter-series dependencies by incorporating series-level global characteristics beyond local windows. translated_title: 面向多元时间序列异常检测的尺度鲁棒与全局感知表示学习
translated_abstract: 多元时间序列异常检测（MTSAD）是一项关键任务，旨在识别异常的系统行为，并支持各类现实应用中的可靠运行。尽管MTSAD已取得长足进展，但表示学习中的两个关键挑战仍未被充分探索：（C1）如何学习尺度鲁棒的时间表示，以捕捉不同时间尺度上的异常；（C2）如何学习全局感知的关系表示，通过融合超越局部窗口的序列级全局特征来捕捉序列间的依赖关系。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了STAGER，一种新颖的方法，可联合学习两种互补的表示：尺度鲁棒的时间表示与全局感知的关系表示。具体而言，STAGER采用（1）尺度鲁棒的时间编码器，通过构建多尺度时间有向无环图（DAG）来学习尺度鲁棒的时间表示……
tldr: 本文提出STAGER方法，通过联合学习尺度鲁棒的时间表示与全局感知的关系表示，解决了多元时间序列异常检测中跨时间尺度异常捕捉与序列间全局依赖建模两大关键挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes STAGER, a novel method that jointly learns scale-robust temporal representations and global-aware relational representations to tackle two key challenges in multivariate time series anomaly detection: capturing anomalies across different temporal scales and modeling inter-series dependencies with series-level global characteristics.
